title: Route nodes by declared capability needs
narrative: Nubble prefers declaring what a step needs instead of hard-coding a model id, then picking among available classes. Accepts inspiration requirement 13[^insp-r13].
implementation: `route_for_capability_needs` in `mechaharness.routing` selects a model class from declared needs and available classes. `CliInstrumentor` verb `route_capabilities` exposes the host diagnostic.
